_doc: Single source of truth for public-route cache policy + perf budgets. Every src/app/**/page.tsx not under admin|api|alerts|sign-in|sign-up|submit|embed|design-lab|portal|watchlist|you|refer|brief|s should appear here, or be ignored via perf/.perfignore. Used by scripts/perf-routes.mjs (cache+TTFB+transfer asserter), scripts/perf-bundle.mjs (route JS budget + forbidden-import detector), scripts/check-routes-config.mjs (completeness lint), and .github/workflows/cron-warmup.yml (warmup matrix). MAJORLY TRIMMED 2026-05-19 after UI v4 archive — only the home placeholder + /api/health probe survive. Routes will be re-added as the rebuild lands new pages.

routes.reason: health probe reflects live state through a short shared cache; cron-freshness-check polls this every 15 min
